summary: Describes data structures and API support for Mobile IPv6 as an extension to the Advanced Sockets API for IPv6. Just as that API exposes extension headers and ICMPv6, this gives programs the same level of access for Mobile IPv6 components. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Programmers need ways to use a feature that lets a device keep its address while moving. This gives them the commands in their programming tools.
